evidence: Validation fails closed for missing or modified governed files, unapproved governance records, broken or incomplete workflows, absent page contracts, package-escaping and network-dependent links, unexpected hosted administration routes, redirected inventory entries, and reference changes during validation.
The approved reference refuses in-place hash regeneration; its generator is reproduced from immutable snapshots and every generated governed artifact must retain the approved canonical hash.

The supplied approved reference passes and the deterministic report identifies RO-UI-ACADEMIC-MINIMAL-1.3 version 1.3 with the exact sorted map of all 54 governed SHA-256 values and aggregate package SHA-256 cc4c2ba45978f2ebf3e97f930841eef51297e7fb81e741a1e980bf5e5493a25f.
The report also binds the exact page, HTML-document, workflow-profile, and capability-record counts and records generator reproducibility.

The validator performs no browser launch or network request: it parses HTML with the Python standard library, resolves local targets inside the canonical package, and runs the local generator in an isolated temporary directory.
Two exact-commit runs produced byte-identical reports, and the validation gate is now mandatory in the foundation profile.
